name: cacsms-traders
description: Cacsms-Traders platform — run API and web together with npm run dev

scripts.dev: node scripts/pre-dev.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "py -3.14 scripts/run_api.py" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev --prefix apps/web -- --port 5173 --strictPort"
